summary: Unit tests for kb search ranking and kb write. Holds the ranking-contract regression: 'staleness LABELS but does not rank; superseded is still a hard tier' asserts a stale note that covers every query term outranks a fresh note that covers fewer, while a superseded note stays last. Until 2026-07-30 this same test asserted the exact opposite order, so an inverted expectation here is the signal that freshness has been re-introduced into the sort. Its fixture writes real files and drifts one of them, so it exercises live stamping rather than mocked anchor state.

summary: Unit tests for kb search ranking and kb write. Holds two contract regressions worth knowing before editing either area: 'staleness LABELS but does not rank' asserts a stale note covering every query term outranks a fresher note covering fewer while a superseded note stays last (this test asserted the OPPOSITE order until 2026-07-30, so an inverted expectation here means freshness has crept back into the sort); and 'a metadata-only write does NOT re-verify the anchor' asserts a title-only write records an empty `verified` and no hash, while a write carrying a summary re-stamps. Both fixtures write real files and drift them, so they exercise live hashing rather than mocked anchor state.
